watches.name: Gold White Croc
watches.description: White croc-embossed leather extends across the full-width dial and strap of this Swiss Made automatic timepiece, creating an unexpected interplay of softness and structure. A sculptural gold rectangular case frames the textured leather, bringing warmth and visual balance.

watches.name: Gold Black Croc
watches.description: Deep black croc-embossed leather extends beyond the strap and across the full-width dial, framed by a polished gold rectangular case. The rich black texture against warm gold gives this Swiss Made automatic timepiece its bold, unmistakable character.

specsRaw.Colour: Gold Gold Strap size: Small Small Large

watches.name: Watch Tray
watches.description: Structured valet tray and matching box system for organizing watches and daily essentials. Crafted in matte black vegan leather, it creates a defined layout for storage, keeping accessories arranged with clarity and order.

watches.name: Watch Stand
watches.description: Sculptural watch stand and matching box set in matte black vegan leather, designed to display and protect timepieces. Defined by clean geometry and a minimal silhouette, it provides a dedicated resting point for watches in the home or on display.

watches.name: Automatic Watch Winder
watches.description: Precision-engineered watch winder designed to maintain Swiss automatic movements. Finished in brushed black stainless steel, it operates with a whisper-quiet Japanese Mabuchi motor and multiple rotation settings for consistent winding performance.

watches.name: Gold Waves
watches.description: A sculptural gold rectangular timepiece defined by soundwave form across a skeleton dial. The radial surface expands in measured concentric rhythm, echoing analog speaker systems. Powered by a Swiss Made automatic movement, it translates mechanical precision into visual vibration.

watches.name: Black Stereo Diamond
watches.description: Defined by deep tonal contrast, this Swiss Made automatic timepiece is hand-set with 93 black diamonds across an openwork skeleton dial. The matte black DLC-coated rectangular case creates a modern monochromatic composition, revealing subtle depth through resonance and light.

watches.name: Steel Stereo Diamond
watches.description: Grounded in industrial design, this Swiss Made automatic diamond timepiece is crafted in stainless steel. The metallic case frames a structured layout of 93 natural diamonds, defined by sharp lines and precise composition. A modern rectangular silhouette refined by mechanical rhythm.

watches.name: Gold Stereo Diamond
watches.description: An opulent gold rectangular timepiece hand-set with 93 natural diamonds. Each gemstone contrasts the skeleton dial, revealing the Swiss Made automatic movement beneath. The interplay of gold, diamonds, and openwork design creates a striking expression of light and movement.

watches.name: Gold Sunray
watches.description: Inspired by vintage record players, this Swiss Made automatic timepiece evokes the surface of spinning vinyl. The sunray-brushed skeleton dial shifts with every movement of light. The gold rectangular case reflects ambient surroundings, revealing the openworked movement within.

watches.name: Gold Mirror
watches.description: A Swiss Made automatic timepiece capturing the energy of the disco era. The gold rectangular case frames a reflective skeleton dial that shifts with every angle, creating a continuous interplay between light and motion. Expressive and radiant, it transforms illumination into rhythm.

watches.name: VIEREN x Sébastien Preschoux
watches.description: Paris-based Sébastien Preschoux creates intricate geometric systems defined by rhythm and precision. On this Swiss Made automatic timepiece, his hand-drawn structures become a study in balance, transforming meticulous linework into immersive visual poetry.

watches.name: VIEREN x Kelly Violet
watches.description: London-based Kelly Violet is known for her darkly romantic blackwork tattoos. Her chrysanthemum motif is reinterpreted as a hand-painted dial on a Swiss Made automatic timepiece, capturing the tension between bloom and decay through intricate monochrome detail.

watches.name: VIEREN x Cosmodernism
watches.description: Polish artist Kamil Czapiga, working under the moniker Cosmodernism, merges science and abstraction through fluid, microchemical compositions. His experimental ink work captures ephemeral moments suspended between structure and chaos, rendered on a Swiss Made automatic timepiece.

watches.name: VIEREN x Roberta Boffo
watches.description: Italian artist Roberta Boffo transforms monochrome ink into intricate compositions through an intuitive approach. On this Swiss Made automatic timepiece, she translates her signature language into a hand-painted dial, balancing complexity and restraint in every stroke.

watches.name: VIEREN x James Goldcrown
watches.description: James Goldcrown’s signature Bleeding Hearts, seen from Tokyo to Miami, reimagine love as a global visual language. On this Swiss Made automatic timepiece, the hand-painted composition becomes a vibrant kinetic surface, translating street art energy into horological form.

watches.name: V Collector's Set
watches.description: The V Collection unites five hand-painted Swiss Made automatic timepieces into a curated archive of contemporary horology. Presented in the signature Art Crate, it is conceived as an exhibition object for the modern collector. Crafted in matte black wood with a sculptural V-pattern and white canvas lining, it is designed as a gallery-grade display system.

watches.name: Matte White
watches.description: A study in modern minimalism, this Swiss Made automatic timepiece draws from brutalist architecture. The sculptural polished stainless steel rectangular case frames a tonal matte white dial defined by geometric precision and understated 18K gold accents.

watches.name: White Croc
watches.description: An unconventional all-white Swiss Made automatic timepiece, featuring a white Cerakote-coated rectangular case and croc-embossed leather extending across the full-width dial and strap. With color reduced to a single tone, the leather's intricate texture becomes the defining detail.

watches.name: Black Croc
watches.description: Defined by deep black croc-embossed leather extending across the dial and strap, this Swiss Made automatic timepiece creates a continuous surface of texture. Framed by a polished stainless steel rectangular case, the composition balances tactile richness with sculptural restraint.

specsRaw.Colour: Silver Silver Strap size: Small Small Large

watches.name: Black Diamond
watches.description: An all-black Swiss Made automatic timepiece defined by a tonal geometric dial hand-set with 31 black diamonds and a DLC-coated rectangular case. Subtle reflections emerge against the darkened surfaces, bringing understated brilliance to its precise sculptural form.

watches.name: White Diamond
watches.description: A refined Swiss Made automatic timepiece defined by a geometric dial hand-set with 31 natural diamonds. The polished stainless steel rectangular case frames the architectural composition with clarity, allowing light to move across each facet with controlled brilliance.

watches.name: Matte Black
watches.description: Monochromatic by design, this Swiss Made automatic timepiece features a deep matte black DLC-coated rectangular case and tonal geometric dial. Together, they form a continuous architectural surface where contrast dissolves and form becomes the focus.
